The single legible line did not beg for rescue; it gave thanks for a light kept burning across thirty years of solitary nights.", "w02": "凌晨四点，整座城市的喧嚣褪去，沉入最深沉的梦境。高架桥上空无一人，唯有昏黄的路灯将清冷的光芒拉得极长。环卫工人挥动扫帚，在空旷的街道上划出沙沙的轻响；便利店暖光的玻璃窗内，蒸包机正静静升腾着热气。黑夜与黎明在此刻悄然交接，整座巨兽般的都市正屏息等待着第一缕晨光的唤醒。", "w03": "- Recursion is when a rule or task solves a big problem by doing a smaller version of the exact same task over and over.\n- It is just like standing between two mirrors and seeing smaller and smaller reflections of yourself stretching on forever.\n- Every recursive task must have an \"exit rule,\" like reaching the last nesting doll, so it knows when to finally stop."}
